  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS amt
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_amount" ca
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_payment" lp
    WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  )
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
res AS (
  SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS amt
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_amount" ca
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_reserve" lr
    WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  )
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
  c.Catastrophe_Identifier,
  cat.Catastrophe_Name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS claims,
  COALESCE(SUM(p.amt), 0) AS loss_paid,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.amt), 0) AS loss_reserved,
  100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(p.amt), 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(p.amt), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(r.amt), 0), 0) AS paid_share_of_incurred_pct
FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim" c
JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."catastrophe" cat
  ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = cat.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN pay p ON p.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN res r ON r.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Catastrophe_Identifier, cat.Catastrophe_Name
ORDER BY c.Catastrophe_Identifier
LIMIT 500

WITH claims AS (
  SELECT la.Location_Address_Identifier AS addr_id,
         la.Line_1_Address AS line_1_address,
         SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS incurred_loss
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim" c
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_amount" ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."insurable_object" io ON c.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."geographic_location" gl ON io.Geographic_Location_Identifier = gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."location_address" la ON gl.Location_Address_Identifier = la.Location_Address_Identifier
  WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_payment")
     OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_reserve")
  GROUP BY la.Location_Address_Identifier, la.Line_1_Address
),
prem AS (
  SELECT la.Location_Address_Identifier AS addr_id,
         SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_amount" pa
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_coverage_detail" pcd
    ON pa.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."insurable_object" io ON pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."geographic_location" gl ON io.Geographic_Location_Identifier = gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."location_address" la ON gl.Location_Address_Identifier = la.Location_Address_Identifier
  GROUP BY la.Location_Address_Identifier
)
SELECT c.addr_id AS location_address_identifier,
       c.line_1_address,
       c.incurred_loss,
       p.total_premium,
       c.incurred_loss * 1.0 / NULLIF(p.total_premium, 0) AS loss_to_premium_ratio
FROM claims c
LEFT JOIN prem p ON p.addr_id = c.addr_id
ORDER BY loss_to_premium_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 500
